newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria sells Jordan 100,000 tonnes black barley.
newsitem.headline: Syria sells Jordan 100,000 tonnes black barley.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has sold Jordan 100,000 tonnes of black barley at dollars 138 per tonne, a senior GECPT official said on Sunday.
He told Reuters the agreement was reached during talks in Damascus between GECPT officials and a Jordanian Ministry of Supply team. The barley would be delivered immediately.
An official initially reported that 50,000 tonnes had been sold but the figure was later corrected to 100,000 tonnes.
The contract would bring Jordan's imports of Syrian barley during the last seven months to over 450,000 tonnes.
The barley would be exported by a joint Syrian-Jordanian transportation company by road from the GECPT's stores in the Syrian city of Daraa on the border with Jordan, the official said.
